skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 300% ATK DMG. Reduces the DMG Rate of all enemies by 30% for 1 round.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 450% ATK DMG. Reduces the DMG Rate of all enemies by 50% for 1 round.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, [Evolve] 2 targets that are under [Unyielding] or an Ignore DMG state and deals 200% ATK as Extra DMG. At battle start, gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion] for 2 rounds. Permanently increases own HP. [Evolve]: Immediately removes the target’s [Unyielding] and Ignore DMG statuses. There is no activation limit for [Evolve]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, [Evolve] 3 targets that are under [Unyielding] or an Ignore DMG state and deals 200% ATK as Extra DMG. At battle start, gains 65% [Instant DMG Evasion] for 2 rounds. Permanently increases own HP. [Evolve]: Immediately removes the target’s [Unyielding] and Ignore DMG statuses. There is no activation limit for [Evolve]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, [Evolve] 3 targets that are under [Unyielding] or an Ignore DMG state and deals 300% ATK as Extra DMG. At battle start, gains 70% [Instant DMG Evasion] for 2 rounds. Permanently increases own HP. [Evolve]: Immediately removes the target’s [Unyielding] and Ignore DMG statuses. There is no activation limit for [Evolve]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic Effect) (1 Grappler, 1 Duelist, 1 Hi-Tech): Gain 3 energy per round.(Advance Effect) (1 Grappler, 1 Duelist, 1 Hi-Tech, 1 Esper): When battle begins, all allies obtain [Specialized Protection] of 600% original Max HP (removes damage, stackable with extra HP effects, accumulated damage removed will not be more than 15x of his original HP, can be stacked).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 1 energy once per round if any ally triggers CRIT.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 1 energy twice per round if any ally triggers CRIT.

effects.desc: Floors that each cause a direct, additional, charge, or berserk attack to only deal 1 damage.
